messages:
Maya Lopez: Quick idea - run a lightweight community launch around a new OSS reference app + three micro-tutorials. Goal: get devs to try the quickstart and file issues / PRs. Draft brief: https://docs.google.com/example :mag: 
Ethan Wright: Sounds good. Proposed cadence? avoid overlap with product sprint wrap on 8/10. Target webinar for 8/18 so we can include the GA refapp.
Rina Kapoor: I can handle copy and comms. Need 10 business days for email + social cadence: teaser, registration, 2 reminders, post-event follow-up. Also want a short Loom demo for the README.
Jonas Meyer: I'll take the repo and quickstart. Plan: Docker + local dev guide, tiny sample app, and a CI action to run tests. Aim to have README + starter demo by 8/12.
Maya Lopez: For leads, let's gate the starter repo download with an email/company field and tag in HubSpot with "oss_refapp_aug2025". Also add utm_source=community_refapp to all links.
Ethan Wright: Webinar logistics: Tue 8/18 10am PT works. I'll book Zoom, enable recording, and set up auto-captioning.
Rina Kapoor: Draft tweet sample: 
"Hands-on: Redwood RefApp + micro-tutorials to speed up LLM features. Join our launch webinar 8/18 for a live demo & quickstart. Register: https://redwood.ai/refapp?utm_source=community_refapp"
Jonas Meyer: Repo deliverables: quickstart script, sample.env file, local docker-compose, and an examples folder with 2 mini apps. I'll open PRs early for review.
Maya Lopez: Routing plan: registration form -> HubSpot contact + tag -> Slack notification to #sales-insights -> AE assignment if company size >50 or requests enterprise help. Also score leads by webinar_attended + repo_star + demo_request.
marketing-bot: Created ticket MKT-9012, calendar event, and checklist: repo PR, tutorials draft, landing page, webinar booking, promo assets.
Ethan Wright: Post-webinar workflow: record -> upload to YouTube -> embed in README and tutorial pages -> include feedback survey link. Make sure to capture eval use-cases.
Rina Kapoor: I'll prepare 2 short social clips (30s) from the demo and a 90s highlight for LinkedIn. Also will draft the follow-up email template with CTA to star the repo and request a demo.
Jonas Meyer: Can someone provide latency / cost numbers to include in the release note? We should include a short performance section (local dev vs Redwood hosted).
Maya Lopez: I'll coordinate with infra for sample numbers. Also want a brief migration guide for teams switching from hosted eval endpoints to local refapp testing.
Ethan Wright: I'll confirm Zoom and webinar registration settings by Monday.
Rina Kapoor: I'll share first-round copy by Friday and a short storyboard for the clips.
Jonas Meyer: PRs coming this week. Will ping reviewers on completion.
Maya Lopez: Great momentum. Let's do a 20-minute sync next Tue to align assets. Thanks everyone :tada:
